sources.title: Reliance Industries Limited – Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) All India Hiring 2027
sources.reliability: High for the details explicitly stated on this listing; it is the opportunity page used for registration, not a complete public test specification.
observed_facts: Eligible branches shown include Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Fire, Civil and Instrumentation (degree titles must be mapped by RIL).
Assessment round is described as online Cognitive Test + Subject Matter.
Play/start access is branch-specific.
Candidates are instructed to take the test in a closed, quiet, private environment.
The listing does not publicly state exact question count, duration, marks distribution or detailed syllabus.
sources.use_in_app: Show confirmed process facts only; show missing test details as Unknown / Await official instructions.

sources.title: Reliance Industries Graduate Engineering Trainee GET interview questions (candidate-submitted reports)
sources.recency: Includes candidate reports dated 30 Apr, 5 May and 2 Oct 2026
sources.reliability: Medium-low: anonymous self-reports; useful for themes, not an official syllabus or guaranteed assessment format.
observed_facts: A 5 May 2026 GET candidate report says interview discussion was mostly about the candidate project and industrial instrumentation.
A 30 Apr 2026 report describes an easy-to-moderate combined HR/technical discussion and checking basic undergraduate knowledge.
These are interview reports, not validated details of the 2027 online assessment.
sources.use_in_app: Display as candidate-reported interview themes with date and anonymous-source disclaimer.

sources.title: Reliance Industries Maintenance Engineer – Instrumentation interview experience
sources.reliability: Medium-low: single anonymous report and a different position/selection cycle.
observed_facts: The report describes an online assessment covering aptitude and reasoning followed by interview stages.
It recommends fundamentals of industrial measurement (pressure, temperature, level and flow), PLC/DCS, projects/internship and CV extracurriculars.
This is not the same role or cycle as RIL GET 2027.
sources.use_in_app: Use as a topic-priority signal only, clearly labelled previous-cycle candidate report.

sources.title: Reliance Industries GET interview questions & experience guide – forum thread
sources.recency: Posts surfaced from 2024; older reports are also present in the thread.
sources.reliability: Low-to-medium: anonymous and mixed-discipline reports; details conflict and are historical.
observed_facts: Multiple posters discuss aptitude/reasoning and core technical sections in prior RIL hiring contexts.
Some reported formats vary substantially by campus, discipline and year; question counts and durations conflict.
One report mentions industrial instrumentation/flowmeters, PLC/SCADA, core subjects and project/internship discussion.
sources.use_in_app: Do not use old forum numbers as a prediction for the 2027 test. Extract broad preparation themes only.

sources.title: NPTEL Industrial Instrumentation course
sources.recency: Course archive; educational content remains useful, not a current hiring announcement.
observed_facts: Covers static/dynamic characteristics, strain gauges/load cells, RTD/thermocouple/thermistor, flow measurements, LVDT/capacitance sensors, piezoelectric sensors, pressure, optoelectronic sensors, pH and viscosity.
sources.use_in_app: Use as a curriculum/resource link; link users to the host rather than copying videos or course content.

sources.title: NPTEL Industrial Instrumentation course page
observed_facts: Topic list includes RTD, thermocouples, thermistor, LVDT, capacitance transducers, multiple flowmeter lectures, pressure sensors, signal conditioning, piezoelectric and ultrasonic sensors, smart sensors and analytical measurements.

sources.title: IndiaBIX – Aptitude, logical reasoning and verbal ability practice
sources.reliability: Useful for extra practice; third-party content and not RIL-specific.
observed_facts: Provides online tests across aptitude, data interpretation, verbal ability, logical reasoning, verbal reasoning, and engineering topics.
sources.use_in_app: Show as external practice links; do not copy its question bank into local data.

sources.use_in_app: External practice link for quantitative aptitude.

sources.title: IndiaBIX online logical reasoning tests
sources.use_in_app: External practice link for logical reasoning.

sources.title: IndiaBIX online verbal ability tests
sources.use_in_app: External practice link for verbal ability.

sources.title: Siemens SITRAIN – Process Instrumentation Introduction
sources.reliability: High for describing industrial instrumentation topic areas; course may be paid and region dependent.
observed_facts: Covers pressure, temperature, level, flow, electro-pneumatic positioners and instrument selection.
sources.use_in_app: Use as an industrial context resource link; indicate availability/cost may vary.

sources.title: Google Antigravity IDE overview
observed_facts: Antigravity is an agentic development environment integrating agents in workspace, terminal and browser and supporting end-to-end build/iteration workflows.
sources.use_in_app: The build prompt should ask Antigravity to implement, run, inspect and test the local application.

sources.title: Google Antigravity agent settings and permission controls
observed_facts: Agent settings govern terminal command execution, non-workspace file access and sandbox behavior.
sources.use_in_app: Recommend review/ask-before-execution for destructive commands and keeping work inside the project workspace.
